label: Recorded evidence: $ZED_CUSTOM_type
command: dxn review "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE" "$ZED_CUSTOM_type" | sed -n "s/^Wrote //p" | while IFS= read -r page; do zed "$page"; done

label: Stale evidence: $ZED_CUSTOM_type
command: dxn review "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE" "$ZED_CUSTOM_type" --stale | sed -n "s/^Wrote //p" | while IFS= read -r page; do zed "$page"; done

command: dxn review "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE" "$ZED_CUSTOM_parent.$ZED_CUSTOM_type" --stale | sed -n "s/^Wrote //p" | while IFS= read -r page; do zed "$page"; done
